_meta.source: Teks asli heartodex (descriptionOriginal di file data) dengan salah ketik yang jelas dibetulkan. descriptionOriginal tetap apa adanya.

bamboo: A hardy and versatile plant that grows in moist areas.
penny-bun: True to its name, this mushroom earns its title from its thick, meaty body resembling a bread bun.
bizarre-penny-bun-purple: Warning: This mushroom's threat level has reached purple alert! Do not eat!!!
bizarre-penny-bun-red: Warning: This mushroom's threat level has reached red alert! Do not eat!!!
bizarre-penny-bun-pink: Warning: This mushroom's threat level has reached pink alert! Do not eat!!!
button-mushroom: It really does look like a perfect button.
bizarre-button-mushroom-blue: A blue mushroom straight out of a fairytale—beautiful but dangerous. Do not eat!!!
bizarre-button-mushroom-red: A red mushroom straight out of a fairytale—beautiful but dangerous. Do not eat!!!
bizarre-button-mushroom-green: A green mushroom straight out of a fairytale—beautiful but dangerous. Do not eat!!!
flawless-fluorite: A rare ore, often used by Moabit's little moles for disguise.
starfall-shard: Obtained by mining Starfall Ore during a meteor shower. Can be redeemed for various souvenirs at Doris's Fortune Store.
raspberry: Some call it "golden fruit" for its heart benefits.
timber: A common type of timber, gathered from trees near homes.
quality-timber: High-quality timber. Head to the forest on the island's east for quick collection.
roaming-oak-timber: Extremely rare timber, gathered by rescuing a lively friend in trouble.
rare-timber: Valuable timber, gathered from trees with thick trunks.
weed: You can get it from your crops.
mandarin: Sweet and tart, a simple way to replenish vitamins.
apple: An apple a day keeps the doctor away.
matsutake: Though matsutakes often appear in groups, they're not easy to find—a true delicacy.
ore: A widely distributed ore, gathered from black rocks near the sea.
stone: A frequently found ore, gathered from rocks near homes.
branch: A very common material that can be gathered from bushes.
oyster-mushroom: With its flat cap, it loves playing stacking games with other mushrooms.
bizarre-oyster-mushroom-purple: Stay away from this purple bizarre oyster mushroom. Do not eat!!!
bizarre-oyster-mushroom-orange: Stay away from this orange bizarre oyster mushroom. Do not eat!!!
bizarre-oyster-mushroom-pink: Stay away from this pink bizarre oyster mushroom. Do not eat!!!
shiitake: When the air is damp, shiitake mushrooms pop up everywhere holding up their little umbrellas.
bizarre-shiitake-blue: Blue top, white base—one taste, and it's your final place.
bizarre-shiitak-black: Black top, white base—one taste, and it's your final place.
bizarre-shiitake-red: Red top, white base—one taste, and it's your final place.
black-truffle: Known as the "diamond of the fungi," it loves hiding in small pits.
glasswort: Rich in dietary fiber, this "ginseng of the sea" is a healthy favorite on the modern dining table.
sea-grape: Tiny, glistening green pearls - the caviar of the plant world.
wakame: The "King of Seaweed" - delicious no matter how you cook it.
tall-mustard: Unrelated to garlic, yet it carries the pungent, spicy kick of both garlic and mustard greens.
fiddlehead: The "King of Wild Greens." Blanching in boiling water before cooking removes harmful substances.
mustard-greens: Looks green and harmless, but carries a sharp, pungent aroma.
